newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Bosnian Serb to appear before U.N. tribunal.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian Serb to appear before U.N. tribunal.

text.p: A Bosnian Serb arrested by British troops in Bosnia earlier this month will make his first appearance before the U.N. Yugoslavia war crimes tribunal on Wednesday, the tribunal said.
Milan Kovacevic, former director of a hospital at Prijedor in northwest Bosnia, was seized in an operation in which another suspected Serb war criminal, Simo Drljaca, was shot dead.
Kovacevic is scheduled to make a brief appearance before tribunal judges (1430 GMT) to answer charges of complicity in genocide against Moslems and Croats in 1992.
The alleged offences are said to have been committed during a Serb campaign of ethnic cleansing in Prijedor at the start of the inter-ethnic war in Bosnia.
The initial appearance of a suspect before the Hague tribunal is usually followed by a pre-trial phase of several months before full hearings get under way.
Kovacevic's first appearance in the courtroom was delayed while he underwent medical tests.
